item.title: El Niño forecast to intensify, increasing likelihood of extreme weather
item.description: The UN World Meteorological Organization reported strengthening El Niño conditions in the tropical Pacific. More blistering heatwaves and other weather extremes are becoming increasingly likely across the world now and in coming months, linked to strengthening El Niño conditions in the tropical Pacific, the UN World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said on Friday. item.title: Who's Shipping Bananas To Russia, And Who's Shipping Cocaine?
item.description: A Systema investigation found that banana shipments to St. Petersburg sometimes conceal cocaine. Shipments of bananas to St. Petersburg sometimes conceal a contraband cargo: cocaine. A Systema investigation finds that two companies with roles in the delivery and further distribution of the fruit are controlled by Russians with ties to longtime associates of President Vladimir Putin. item.title: As Iran Prepares Elaborate Funeral For Khamenei, Many Recall A Brutal Leader
item.description: Iran's government is preparing a multiday funeral for late Supreme Leader Ali Kham Iran's government is preparing a multiday funeral ceremony for late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, who died in US and Israeli strikes in February. item.title: Culture war killing America’s response to demographic decline
item.description: The Supreme Court affirmed birthright citizenship under the 14th Amendment. This ruling grants automatic US citizenship to anyone born in the country. It includes children of undocumented immigrants and temporary visa holders, a policy the Trump administration had previously challenged. Birthright citizenship is the law of the land. The Supreme Court has once again ruled that the 14th Amendment gives automatic citizenship to anyone born in the US.
